news.headline: Jensen Huang is back: Does Washington have a seat in the boardroom?
news.summary: As Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang and investors add a trillion dollars to the stock, Deirdre Bosa dives into the White House's role in his return and asks General Catalyst's Madhu Namburi, who spent 25 years advising tech boards at J.P. Morgan, how boards, CEOs and dealmakers operate under the new rules.
